Hero.title: Songs are better made together
Hero.subtitle: Hydra is a bunch of songwriters, producers and musicians sharing studios, a kitchen and far too much coffee. Every room has its own character. Just like us.

Work.title: Our Work
Work.subtitle: A selection of releases our songwriters and producers have worked on – from K-pop and Swedish pop to Melodifestivalen and Eurovision.

Studios.title: The Studios
Studios.subtitle: Each studio is named after the person who works in it, and sounds like it.

andreas.name: Andreas Studio
andreas.description: This is where the grand piano lives. The room for vocals, piano and anything with strings, from banjo to a custom Taylor built in Nashville.

costa.name: Costa Studio
costa.description: The room for house and club music. Costa works mostly in the box, on Neumann monitors with the DJ setup close at hand.

david.name: David Studio
david.description: The guitar room. Les Paul, Flying V, Strat, twelve-string and lap steel, plus a DX7 and Model D for whatever you can't play with a pick.
features: Gibson Les Paul Studio & Flying V

dennis.name: Dennis Studio
dennis.description: The room for vocals and mixing, preferably in the middle of the night. Its pride and joy is a Tube-Tech CL 1B, and Denniz listens on a pair of old Mackies he wouldn't trade for anything.

simon.name: Simon Studio
simon.description: Synths, guitars and punchy drums. The room where the indie melodies happen.

common.name: Common Areas
common.description: A kitchen, a lounge and room to breathe between takes. This is where songs get talked through, and where the coffee runs out.

About.title: About Hydra
About.paragraph1: On Fredriksbergsgatan in Malmö, a bunch of songwriters and producers have their own studios and share everything else. That's Hydra.
About.paragraph2: Every room and everyone here has their own thing, and we make the most of it so every song and every detail gets what it deserves. We leave no stone unturned.
About.quote: "We built Hydra because it was the studio we'd always wanted to work in ourselves."
About.paragraph3: The best tool in a studio isn't the console, it's another pair of ears. Here you'll find everything from punchy drums and cranked JCM 800 guitars to a grand piano, horns and dance music, all just one door away.

Services.title: How We Work
Services.subtitle: We say no more often than yes. Not to be difficult, but because we want every song to go all the way. That takes the right conditions: artists who know what they want to say, and the time and resources to do it properly.

songwriting.title: Songwriting
songwriting.description: It's where everything starts, and what we do most. We write together with the artist and bring in more of the crew when a song needs a fresh angle.

production.title: Production
production.description: From first idea to finished song. The instruments and the musicians are in the building, so ideas can be tried on the spot.

recording.title: Recording
recording.description: We record vocals and instruments here. When a song needs a live room, for drums for example, we go to one of our partner studios.

mixing.title: Mixing
mixing.description: Everyone here mixes, and sometimes we split the work between us or bring in an outside engineer. What decides it is what the song needs.

mastering.title: Mastering
mastering.description: We handle the last step ourselves too. Sometimes we bring in outside help, and then we pick someone who suits that particular song.

collaboration.title: Collaborations
collaboration.description: We do the whole chain ourselves, but we happily bring in other studios and engineers when there's a reason to. What matters most is that the song gets all the attention it deserves.

Team.title: Meet the Team
Team.subtitle: The people behind the music. A collective of producers, songwriters, and musicians united by a shared passion for sound.

andreas.name: Andreas "Stone" Johansson
andreas.description: Grand piano, long-renowned songwriter and producer. Fantastic pianist and meticulously fussy. In every sense of the word.
andreas.likes: Editing, to the point where he never stops.

david.name: David Fremberg
david.description: With years of artist and live experience, he accounts for the most amps and live elements in his recordings.
david.likes: KISS more than anything, and his rediscovered love for trad jazz.
david.hates: Throwing away emails in the inbox.

denniz.name: Denniz Jamm
denniz.description: Calm, methodical, night owl. Always works the night shift. Denniz loves to mix and has a special ear for taking the mix to new heights.
denniz.likes: Sleeping in, nightclubs, and mixing dance music.
denniz.hates: Cold weather — happily flees when there's no warmth left in Malmö.

costa.name: Costa Leon
costa.description: Hydra's own DJ, with years of experience as a producer and songwriter, but also has an artist career alongside his creative work. Costa keeps a high tempo but still takes it easy. He's Greek, after all.
costa.hates: Early mornings. But he always seems to still be around come morning.

simon.name: Simon Peyron
simon.description: Also known as "celebrity Simon", with the epithets "baker on kids' TV" and metal singer, Simon is a bright spark at Hydra. With extensive experience in production, mixing, and songwriting, Simon is a nerd to his fingertips.
simon.hates: That this website never gets finished, but SOON!

peter.name: Peter Zimny
peter.description: Official brass master. If it has a hole, he'll blow into it — and make it sound good too. One of Sweden's most sought-after multi-instrumentalists. Saxophone, flute, clarinet — you name it.
peter.likes: Water fasting, tennis, and talking about water fasting and tennis.

johan.name: Johan Lundén
johan.description: He hasn't been assigned an animal yet — a ceremony is planned for later this year. Johan has extensive experience in songwriting and audio post-production for film and gaming. We're very happy to have him on board.
johan.hates: Not really sure, he always seems so happy.

thomas.name: Thomas "Tomme" Wallén
thomas.description: The house dad, the reassuring teacher on a chaotic playground. Thomas is the oil in the machine — making sure songs reach artists and that artists actually show up now and then. Without him, no Hydra.
thomas.likes: Royalty reporting and making Excel files.
thomas.hates: Royalty reporting and making Excel files — so now he has a system for it.
